coverage_of_risk.rationale: No tests exist, so none of the risky logic — data shaping, sorting, filtering, URL state, error handling — is covered by anything the team will own.

evidence: app/src — zero test files (grep for test/assert/expect finds only comments)
behaviour_not_implementation.rationale: There are no tests, so nothing asserts observable behaviour either.

evidence: app/src/pages/home.ts:108-118 — live bug (debounce timer clobbers URL after navigating away) already present, nothing would catch it
app/src/table.ts:27 — both-null tie-break ignores sort direction, undetectable without a test
app/src/pages/home.ts:74 — out-of-range page clamps in view but URL keeps ?page=999, untested
regression_power.rationale: A suite that doesn't exist can't fail; at least one demonstrable bug is already in the untested code.

evidence: app/ — no tests to be noisy or lean
signal_to_noise.rationale: No tests, so no noise — but also no signal.

findings.issue: No test infrastructure whatsoever: no runner, no test script, no test files; only acceptance tests in tests/ guard the app.
findings.suggestion: Add vitest for app/src/format.ts, table.ts and api.ts (pure logic, near-zero setup) and a small Playwright config for router/error-page smoke tests.

findings.issue: Search debounce timer is never cancelled on navigation; firing after navigation calls updateUrl and replaces the current Pokémon page's URL with /?q=… (url-state.ts:16-22), while the old view stays rendered.
findings.suggestion: Cancel the timer on unmount / check isShown() before calling updateUrl, and add a test that types then immediately clicks a card.

findings.issue: getAll assumes a single ?limit=100000 response and ignores List.next; truncation (server cap, chunked fetch, refactor) would go undetected.
findings.suggestion: Follow List.next until exhausted (or assert count === results.length) and unit-test with a mocked paginated response.

findings.issue: Sort comparator is subtle and untested: both-null rows keep original order regardless of direction, nulls always sort last in both directions; a refactor would easily break ordering silently.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test sortableTable ordering per column, null-last behavior in both directions, and tie stability.

findings.issue: Out-of-range ?page=NNN is clamped for display but the URL is not rewritten, so the URL disagrees with the rendered page and pagination links (which embed the clamped number) — untested.
findings.suggestion: Normalize filters.page against totalPages and replaceState the corrected URL; test with ?page=999.

findings.issue: latestFlavorText depends on findLast (last English entry) plus \s+ collapse — a swap to find or a lost trim regresses every flavor paragraph with no failing test.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test latestFlavorText against entries with \n/\f, multiple languages, and out-of-order English entries.

findings.issue: Promise cache: failed requests are evicted (retry works) and in-flight requests deduped — both behaviours are load-bearing and untested; caching a rejection would permanently break a page until reload.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test the cache with a stubbed fetch: dedupe of concurrent gets, eviction after rejection, 404 → NotFoundError.

findings.issue: Move grouping: dedup by (url, level), version-group ordering by order, and METHOD_ORDER ranking are all untested and easy to break in a refactor of the moves section.
findings.suggestion: Extract move-grouping into a pure function and unit-test dedup, method order, and level-up sorting.

findings.issue: speciesCards dedups by id, filters alternate forms, and falls back to the pokemon name when the species map misses — the fallback could generate a non-species URL (e.g. /pokemon/deoxys-normal) for mismatched default varieties.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test speciesCards with a fixture containing forms >10000 and a default variety whose name differs from the species name.

findings.issue: Error mapping (NotFoundError/URIError → not-found, others → error page) and the navigation race guard are untested.
findings.suggestion: Add Playwright tests hitting an unknown route and a 500ing resource (mock route) to pin both pages.

summary: The app contains no tests of its own — no runner, no scripts, no cases — so every risky area (data shaping, sorting, filtering, pagination, URL state, error handling) is guarded only by acceptance tests the team won't own. At least one real bug (the search debounce clobbering the URL after navigation) is already hiding in the untested code, and the sort comparator's null handling would likely regress silently. A few vitest units over format.ts, table.ts and api.ts would be cheap and high-value; they're absent.
